$comment: Director. Owns the task list and the merge, and writes nothing outside
An empty "deny" here is the widest hole this system can have. The role that
can merge must not also be the role that can edit any file in the repo, or
every other permission boundary becomes decorative: the director could make
a change itself and then approve it.
The path confinement is enforced by hooks/write-scope.sh with
ORCH_ROLE=director, not by the globs here — in Claude Code deny beats allow,
so 'deny everything, allow one prefix' cannot be expressed as a rule. What
remains here are the denies that are absolute for every role: history
